newsitem.title: UK: NWE vacuum gas oil down with crude, poor US buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE vacuum gas oil down with crude, poor US buying.

text.p: NWE low sulphur vacuum gas oil prices eased again on Wednesday as numbers in the U.S. followed futures prices lower, traders said.
A barge dealer assessed high sulphur prices at around $155 fob ARA, with the market relatively well supplied, and the spread with low sulphur fuel oil at around $10 a tonne.
Cargoes were quiet, after the sale of a low sulphur cargo out of Lavera on Tuesday at $170 cif Augusta. This involved a freight rate of $6.50 a tonne.
Dealers said notional U.S. arbitrage buying levels in Europe worked out at around $163 fob NWE but business was unlikely as there was no demand in the U.S. for transatlantic-sized pieces.
